source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.
source.location: Results section 2.5 'Notch1 Overexpression Restores Eye Regrowth During V-ATPase Inhibition' (concanamycin A paragraph)

injury: eye ablation at stage 27 (about 85% of eye tissue including lens placode and most of optic cup)

intervention.duration: after surgery to 5 dps (duration as assay time, 5 days)
intervention.description: Eyes treated with concanamycin A after ablation, without NICD activation

readout.method: regrowth scoring of eye size and morphology (regrowth index categories)

notes: Text: 22.6% fully regrown eyes, RI = 131, n=110. Normal = round(22.6% x 110) = 25 (conversion; 25/110 = 22.7%). 'other' = not fully regrown eyes (partial, weak or none regrowth; the text does not split these categories), described per schema. Dose 20 nM from text (cited from ref 41). Dexamethasone not given in this control.

source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.
source.location: Results section 2.5 'Notch1 Overexpression Restores Eye Regrowth During V-ATPase Inhibition' (concanamycin A paragraph)

injury: eye ablation at stage 27 (about 85% of eye tissue including lens placode and most of optic cup)

intervention.agent: concanamycin a plus dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA (hGR/ICD22) and dexamethasone
intervention.duration: after surgery to 5 dps (duration as assay time, 5 days)
intervention.description: Eyes treated with concanamycin A after ablation, with NICD mRNA injected at the four-cell stage and dexamethasone 10 uM added to activate NICD expression

readout.method: regrowth scoring of eye size and morphology (regrowth index categories)

notes: Text: 75.5% fully regrown eyes, RI = 260, n=106 (p < 0.01 vs non-induced concanamycin control). Normal = round(75.5% x 106) = 80 (conversion; 80/106 = 75.5%). 'other' = not fully regrown eyes (split not reported), described per schema. NICD: 0.25 ng hGR/ICD22 mRNA co-injected with GFP into the left dorsal blastomere at four-cell stage (Methods); dexamethasone 10 uM per Methods. Dexamethasone exposure duration not stated explicitly beyond 'after surgery'.
